data.title: Christmas Cookie Swap Party Kit, Printable Invites, Labels, Ballots (PDF Download)
data.description:
Host a Christmas cookie swap without the guesswork: guests sign up so nobody bakes the same cookie, the baking math table tells everyone exactly how many to bring for 6 to 15 guests, every plate gets a label with allergen checkboxes, and ballots crown the best cookie.

What's inside (13 pages):
- How to host in six steps
- Fill-in invitations, 2 per page
- Host countdown from 3 weeks out to the day after
- Guest sign-up sheet with dozens and allergen columns
- Swap rules, packing list and a baking math table for 6 to 15 guests
- Recipe cards, 4 per page
- Cookie labels with allergen checkboxes (nuts, peanuts, dairy, eggs, gluten, soy), 8 per page
- Best Cookie ballots in four categories, 8 per page
- Voting tally sheet and 4 cookie award cards
- Thank-you cards, 4 per page
- Take-home box tags, 12 per page
- Recipe swap list

How it works:
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing ships. After purchase, download the file from your Etsy Purchases page or the email Etsy sends you, then print at home on cardstock and cut along the card edges. Prints on US Letter and fits A4 with "fit to page". For personal use.
